abilities.desc_zh: 冲刺攻击自带不可阻挡 (Unstoppable) 特性，撞击对手将其击退并削减其 20% 能量槽。
abilities.desc_en: Dash attacks feature Unstoppable momentum, knocking the opponent back and draining 20% of their Power.

abilities.desc_zh: 成功格挡近战攻击时，将 35% 伤害反弹给对手，并有 50% 概率使其硬直 1 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Blocking melee strikes reflects 35% damage back to the attacker with a 50% chance to induce hitstun.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次受到攻击或命中重击积累狂暴层数（最多 5 层）。每层提供 +{{var_1}} 攻击力与 +{{var_2}} 物理护甲。
abilities.desc_en: Accumulates Road Rage stacks when struck or landing Heavy Attacks (max 5). Each stack grants +{{var_1}} Attack and +{{var_2}} Armor.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到流血或燃烧效果时，攻击力额外暴涨 30%，能量获取速度提升 50%（越战越疯）。
abilities.desc_en: When suffering from Bleed or Burn, Wildrider gains +30% Attack Rating and +50% Power Rate.

abilities.desc_zh: 生命值归零时触发狂暴锁血，获得 6 秒不可阻挡与必定暴击，攻击无视格挡，绝地死斗！
abilities.desc_en: Upon reaching 0 Health, enters a 6-second death-defying rampage: Unstoppable, 100% Critical Chance, and completely Unblockable attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: 跑车野蛮变线狂暴侧撞，造成强力击退并使对手眩晕 {{var_1}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Wild-sideswipes the opponent, dealing massive knockback and stunning for {{var_1}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 猛踩油门狂暴顶推对手贯穿障碍物，造成破甲降低 {{var_2}} 护甲持续 {{var_3}} 秒，并附加震荡。
abilities.desc_en: Brutally rams the foe through obstacles, reducing Armor by {{var_2}} for {{var_3}}s and inflicting Concussion.

abilities.desc_zh: 顶住能量壁引爆油箱发生冲天爆炸，自身获得狂暴增益提升 {{var_4}} 攻击力持续 {{var_5}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Pins the foe against the energy barrier in an explosion, gaining a Rampage buff boosting Attack by {{var_4}} for {{var_5}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗开始时获得 {{var_3}}~{{var_4}} 初始能量与 +{{var_5}} 攻击力和护甲。仅当队伍中所有成员均具有此协同（飞虎队全员）时激活。
abilities.desc_en: Start the fight with {{var_3}}~{{var_4}} Power and +{{var_5}} Attack & Armor. Bots only benefit if all Bots on the team have this Synergy.

abilities.desc_zh: 与野牛、碎骨魔同队时，近战攻击附带 +{{var_6}} 破甲。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_6}} Armor Piercing on Melee Attacks when teamed with Tantrum or Bonecrusher.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_7}} 攻击力。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_7}} Attack Rating.
